span.p:
8 · Evals
not built yet: golden sets (published changelogs,
reference change tables), trajectory vs outcome,
LLM-as-judge, regression runs

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7 · Guardrails & Permissions
untrusted-data rule, verified citations and proof quotes,
step, time and size caps, web tools only for public documents;
missing: I/O filtering, scoped access, approval for file writes

div.style: color: rgb(250, 248, 245) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Context Engineering
stable-first prompt with cache mark, document register,
memory, summary, plan, history budget

div.style: color: rgb(250, 248, 245) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Loop Engineering
tool loop with parallel calls, step budget,
forced final answer, old tool results elided

div.style: color: rgb(250, 248, 245) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Tool Design
clear names, strict schemas, errors go back
to the model, timeouts, truncated results

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 · Memory
short-term: history + running summary; long-term: notes
written after each answer, recalled per document;
missing: semantic (vector) recall of notes

div.style: color: rgb(250, 248, 245) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 · Orchestration
router (simple / complex / delegate), planner,
subagent handoff with a fresh context

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
9 · Human-in-the-Loop
Change Analyzer: a person approves, edits, adds
and deletes table rows and runs row verification;
missing: approval gates for the Mind's own actions

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
10 · Observability & Tracing
live activity trace, saved conversations with trace,
token and cost tracking per run;
missing: pluggable tracing (MLflow, Langfuse), metrics, alerts
